## Where things stand
Fernhill SAML SSO works end to end on staging: the IdP metadata is loaded, a real login succeeds via a short opaque RelayState stored in Redis, JIT provisioning from the merged PR #415 creates users, and per-tenant group-to-role mapping is implemented in open PR #421. The remaining blocker is the `groups` claim on Fernhill's side; the demo is confirmed for Thursday Nov 19 at 10:00 New York (source: ses-sso-3, src-pr415, src-linear-kes311)

- [in-progress] PR #421 "SAML: group to role mapping + short RelayState" is open with commits 6d0e2b8 and f4a91c7; it needs review/merge (source: ses-sso-3)
- [next-step] Fernhill IT must add the `groups` claim; the request was to be emailed, and their side of the demo checklist is still pending (source: ses-sso-3, src-linear-kes311)
- [next-step] Once the claim exists, verify that `Fernhill-Kestrel-Admins` maps to `admin` and that other users land as `viewer`, including on every subsequent login so Fernhill-side role changes take effect (source: s3-05, s3-06)
- [next-step] Run the Thursday 10:00 ET demo with the `kestrel.test1` account plus an admin test account (source: s3-08, src-linear-kes311)
- [failed-attempt] Full return URL as RelayState failed against Fernhill's ADFS: `MSIS7042: The RelayState parameter is too long` (143 bytes vs the 80-byte SAML cap); replaced by a 22-char opaque ID mapping to a Redis key with a 600 s TTL, deleted on use (source: s3-02, s3-03)
- [failed-attempt] The first JIT test run failed on a case mismatch (`Daniel@Fernhill-Bank.example` vs lowercase domain list); fixed by lowercasing domains (source: s2-02)
- [question] Whether to switch Fernhill's default role to `analyst` and disable SP-initiated login, as Fernhill IT asked — not decided; the user refused pending a conversation with Maya, noting `analyst` is not an existing role (source: s3-06, s3-07, src-slack-fernhill)
- [decision] RelayState is a short opaque ID with the return URL kept server-side in Redis for 10 minutes (source: s3-03)
- [decision] `Fernhill-Kestrel-Admins` maps to `admin`, everything else to `viewer`, configured per tenant and applied on every login (source: s3-05)
- [decision] Default role stays `viewer` and SP-initiated login stays enabled for Fernhill (source: s3-07)
- [decision] Fernhill uses SAML only, no OIDC for now; both SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows are supported (source: s1-03)
- [decision] JIT provisioning creates a user on first SAML login only for verified domains; unverified domains are refused even if the IdP sends them (source: s2-03, src-pr415)
